arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Start hard (shaft 265 W vs CP 200, boat 169 vs 127). Expect settle by min 2-3. If shaft power still above ~210 W after min 3, cue ease. Current helps on leg 1 (push_along +0.26), so expect opposing on even legs: judge effort by pod shaft power, not GPS pace. Target shaft power near CP (~200 W) mid-race, finish sprint last ~800-1000 m depending on pod reserve.
